tools.name: get_flight_route_telemetry
tools.description: Compute full Great Circle & Rhumb Line aviation telemetry for an airport pair across 15 aircraft profiles (e.g. airbus-a350-900ulr, airbus-a350-1000, boeing-787-9, airbus-a321xlr, gulfstream-g650er, boeing-747-8): distance (km/nm/mi), headings, latitude-aware wind profile, 110m sovereign polygon ove

tools.name: recommend_window_seat
tools.description: Analyze solar azimuth, day/night terminator crossings, aurora borealis/australis probability, and time zone shift along a flight path to recommend the best scenic and glare-free window seat (left vs right side).

tools.name: get_airport_hub_profile
tools.description: Retrieve geographic coordinates, hemisphere classification, antipode location, elevation/runway operational briefing (for major hubs), and connected Great Circle routes for a global airport IATA code.

tools.name: find_nearby_corridors
tools.description: Discover alternative major commercial airports near the origin and destination to compare corridor distances and detour penalties.

tools.name: search_airports
tools.description: Search 7,906 global airports by city name, airport name, metro code (e.g. NYC, LON, TYO), or partial IATA code to resolve valid 3-letter IATA airport codes before calling route tools.

tools.name: list_aircraft_profiles
tools.description: List all 15 Orb Vector API aircraft performance profiles (widebodies including A350-900ULR/1000, B787-9, B777-300ER, A380-800, narrowbodies including A321XLR/B737-MAX8, Business Jet G650ER, Concorde, military & GA) with 3-segment Breguet payload-range envelopes.

tools.name: evaluate_aircraft_range
tools.description: Evaluate non-stop range feasibility (`feasibilityStatus`), Breguet allowable payload, flight duration, and all-cabin CO2 emissions across up to 15 aircraft profiles for an airport pair (origin + dest) or mission distance (distance_km). Ranks all 15 aircraft profiles when aircraft is omitted.

tools.name: calculate_multi_leg_route
tools.description: Compute a multi-stop Great Circle itinerary across 2 to 8 airport waypoints across 15 aircraft profiles, returning leg-by-leg distances, headings, range feasibility, cumulative & per-cabin CO2, circuityRatio vs nonstop, 110m sovereign polygon overflight, and solar window-seat guidance.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "search_airports" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Search 7,906 global airports by city name, airport name, metro code (e.g. NYC, LON, TYO), or partial IATA code to resolve valid 3-letter IATA airport codes befo…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
